releases.name: v1.14.0
releases.notes:
## Features
- dra allocator implementation (#3082) [#3082](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3082) ([Jason Deal](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/961af74bda8ee253f253494bcbca003e3b0eb150))
- add zone label to node/nodeclaim lifecycle metrics (#3096) [#3096](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3096) ([Derek Frank](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/8cafe14d22366e4480d2654eadac87dabef9a9e9))
- Support CapacityBuffer API (#3028) [#3028](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3028) ([Sumukha Radhakrishna](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/82671c0b1985c22a1c65f7dee0c49f409148fea6))
- consolidateAfter now applies to destination nodes during consolidation (#3006) [#3006](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3006) ([Derek Frank](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/c129d43cef5d5c636c856e09c3933b9ba26fedcb))
- dra consumable capacity + partitionable devices support (#3110) [#3110](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3110) ([Ryan Mistretta](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/61dff3a2603b8d1bd0715572089919b87b60d9ef))
- add offering overrides and multi-allocatable scheduling support (#3109) [#3109](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3109) ([Jigisha Patil](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/82608e7579521bfb35d9c6f0c4fc9ce9bd3e446f))
- dra allocator integration (#3113) [#3113](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3113) ([Jason Deal](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/11d5e0d453ad0cdc8e3e4dae1d76e2c18191b1da))
- implement Balanced consolidation policy (#2962) [#2962](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/2962) ([James Thompson](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/43964dc54782bc68f15b7da6414c50931dadd07b))
- account for instance type requirements for daemonset scheduling (#2975) [#2975](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/2975) ([GaneshBannur](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/dd79c9f2c9320b5d116681b319cd6f889f9274e0))
- add NormalizedLabelValues for value translation during label normalization (#3104) [#3104](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3104) ([Andy Zhang](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/d77270f8d31a10722bd50f07a0571c2ec1dd514e))
- bump CapacityBuffer to v1beta1 and emit operator_* status metrics (#3129) [#3129](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3129) ([Derek Frank](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/dfa2913482d23773adcb90760eb88c6f758085ab))

## Bug Fixes
- use namespaced name as resourceclaim index (#3102) [#3102](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3102) ([Jason Deal](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/fe46f5c0f2ca0d59fdbb775e78e72ec72bc3aaa7))
- ResourceClaim hydration deadlock (#3122) [#3122](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3122) ([Ryan Mistretta](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/d7a4e1e629c815deb92e73cf299aad47c8a5888b))
- DRA counter tracking mutation race (#3116) [#3116](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3116) ([Ryan Mistretta](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/293a4d716045863fd58b97db2e2331bef5270ee1))
- detect pod-level ResourceClaims in HasDRARequirements (#3124) [#3124](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3124) ([Andrew Mitchell](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/0a96b78cb5e61c8334971539738e43f7aaffe456))
- buffer computeReplicas must take the max of desired replicas and percentage (#3131) [#3131](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3131) ([Sumukha Radhakrishna](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/0435d6d2400dd3d19675e8c662b336ffceb18f71))
- Ensure DaemonSets with '/initialized' and '/registered' are considered during nodeclaim calculations (#2161) [#2161](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/2161) ([Wataru](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/1b4b3e8c829dea93c8a0429e0e27aa68edc98ed7))

## Documentation
- add Clever Cloud provider to README (#3099) [#3099](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3099) ([diodonfrost](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/32e96ad4435d859473df9bc33167aeb1495c7a8e))
- add Hetzner to Karpenter implementations list (#3095) [#3095](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3095) ([Jannes Stubbemann](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/c242dcdc117fc02483831b715fe93ffb5d2355df))
- Support Capacity Buffers in Karpenter (#2898) [#2898](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/2898) ([Sumukha Radhakrishna](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/725879aea46ed9be00a9458b99f4e402a31dc3a0))
- add feature lifecycle, scope guidelines, RFC template, and updated contributing docs (#3049) [#3049](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3049) ([Derek Frank](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/9ae3fd4588096b8becca424010d1361d6f3673e5))
- InPlacePodVerticalScaling Support RFC (#3037) [#3037](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3037) ([Jigisha Patil](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/4a2d93908c01d9852c69df3673b7c7a1071596c9))

## Performance Improvements
- memory optimizations in cluster cost tracking (#3068) [#3068](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3068) ([Ryan Mistretta](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/da3a050dc50a52f97313357b2478e1653b6fc1a4))

## Tests
- replace metrics collection and calibrate resource utilization thresholds for perf tests (#3048) [#3048](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3048) ([Andrew Mitchell](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/8cd2a4016335ecb1456aaedbeea4833f2f371b3c))
- add Capacity Buffers integ tests (#3044) [#3044](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3044) ([Sumukha Radhakrishna](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/cb50f815613d755397a532c3ab079c519550bbe7))
- set NodeClassRef on synthesized NodePool and migrate stale InstanceTypeOptions literals (#3117) [#3117](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3117) ([Andrew Mitchell](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/d5e91d67dae32d8c14230c51495fb26f8b59e6ca))

## Chores
- support consumable capacity and partitionable device fields in core DRA types (#3097) [#3097](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3097) ([Ryan Mistretta](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/2a7dbd24e376f3dc8ef2dd1e6339b57522f8267d))
- add managed dimension to node and pod metrics (#3091) [#3091](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3091) ([Andrew Mitchell](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/e21d298fa0c1b4e55c6b822a1e70b44101f8ae19))
- make Buffer expectations provider/env agnostic (#3114) [#3114](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3114) ([Sumukha Radhakrishna](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/1922ddc3358706a274f36e71a6c0a296f457b063))
- update go-opentelemetry dependencies (#3123) [#3123](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3123) ([Sumukha Radhakrishna](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/14900f21b1655702c05da09d570ba4752baa2304))
- use status resources in pod resource calculation (#3065) [#3065](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3065) ([Jigisha Patil](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/edccab9f02bf03e8bda3a76377c200fe29f2343a))
- make NodeClaim launch timeout configurable (#3112) [#3112](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3112) ([Andrew Mitchell](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/d9e28e932331b14a6e4e0f106a5d2d8ff4e015dd))
- upgrade KWOK to 0.6.0 (#2970) [#2970](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/2970) ([Alvin Bao](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/d20cbaffeff155257349aa7ae54bbe725d58ecd0))
